edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource (from Three Hundred Tang Poems).
edition.zh: 据维基文库（《唐诗三百首》本）。

basis.en: Tang dynasty poem; the author died in 740.

note.en: A whole friendship in forty characters: a simple meal, talk about the crops, and a promise to come back in autumn when the chrysanthemums open. Nothing dramatic happens, and that is the point. The Double Ninth, the ninth day of the ninth month, is the festival for climbing heights and drinking chrysanthemum wine with friends.
note.zh: 四十个字写尽一段友情：一顿家常饭，聊聊庄稼，约好秋天菊花开时再来。什么大事也没有发生，这正是要紧的地方。重阳是九月初九，登高、饮菊花酒、与朋友相聚的节日。

excerpt.orig: 待到重陽日，還來就菊花。
excerpt.en: When the Double Ninth comes round, / I will come back for the chrysanthemums.
excerpt.zh: 待到重阳日，还来就菊花。

gloss.en: 具: to prepare. Chicken and millet: a plain country meal, and in the Analects the dish a recluse serves an honoured guest.
gloss.zh: 具：准备。鸡黍：鸡和黄米饭，农家待客的饭菜。《论语·微子》中隐者“杀鸡为黍而食之”招待子路。

gloss.en: Outside the outer wall of the town.
The threshing floor and the vegetable garden.
To talk of mulberry and hemp, that is, of farming.
gloss.zh: 桑麻：桑树和麻，泛指庄稼农事。

gloss.en: The Double Ninth, the ninth day of the ninth lunar month, when people climbed hills and drank chrysanthemum wine.
gloss.zh: 重阳：农历九月初九，古人有登高、赏菊、饮菊花酒的习俗。

gloss.en: 就: to come near to. To come for the chrysanthemums.

note.en: Forty characters hold a whole friendship without one dramatic word; the plainness is sure, deliberate art, in a modest key.
note.zh: 四十个字写尽一段友情，没有一个激烈的字；平淡是有意为之的功夫，只是调子本就不高。
